knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Heater repair needs a licensed person and is outside the regular service. It is excluded and referred.
A service that depends on a product not yet listed in the operator plan is deferred or referred, with the reason and a review date recorded.
The sample offers a structure only. Its descriptions, prices and times are hypothetical and must not be reused.

practicalCriteria: Service list states inclusions, exclusions and dependencies for each service
Referral list names each excluded task and its route
No sample figure, promised outcome or response time appears in the offer
Each licence-dependent service is marked as referred or left out
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed service list and referral list
Assessor review against the scope rules
stopWorkCriteria: Service offered that requires a licence the business does not hold
Sample prices or response times used as the business's own
